title: Easiest and cheapest
text: Easiest and cheapest. It was cheap and insanely easy. I didnt even need husband's help. Just picked a nice day and put them all up and then looped in the lights. My neighbor took an entire day to do jis lights with whatever way he tried. Def wasnt using these, it took me an hour and a half total between start and having lights up.

description: This is really the best light clip ever. Carefully designed by Adams engineering team, the new all purpose light holder/clip tops the market in ease of use and functionality. The holder/clip holds all types of lights on roofs and gutters- including c5, c7, c9, mini, icicle, rope, LED and specialty lights. It even allows for precise positioning for professional results.
